content:
A listener writes “Our daughter and son in law have a property near Jefferson, TX that we go visit regularly. They’ve had strange occurrences ever since they moved there, and this is their second location.

My son in law Mike, he’s a shoot-first/ask-questions-later kind of guy. He might’ve shot one at their first location, when my son and daughter were there visiting for a week in the summer. Something big (bluff) charged them in the dark in their front yard, so Mike unloaded three 9mm rounds into it and it ran off.

This current property is the most active. They’ve recorded weird howls on their security cameras. They had some very large creature come out of the trees and scare the horses and donkeys while Mike was out there. He tried to record it on his phone, but it was too far away to see clearly.

The latest is from over the Fourth of July this year (2026). I might’ve recorded one on audio making some pretty strange vocalizations. I use really good audio gear, as I’m a quality over quantity kind of guy. Binaural stereo with super low self noise field mics and 32 bit float on another low noise Zoom F3 field recorder. There’s a whole story that I just made a video about, involving my grandson and what we did after we heard the recording. I put it on my little YouTube channel called The Forest Files. Here’s the link:

I didn’t embellish the story at all for the video. It’s all true, and you have my word on that. I’m still actively investigating this area with my grandson’s help. He’s putting out a recorder nearly every night and sending me the audio files the next day. My wife and I live north of Houston in The Woodlands, but we try to make it up to Jefferson once a month. We rescued a horse (the white/gray one from the video!) and they have it there, and she’s become sort of a therapy horse for my wife.

I feel like there’s a lot more to come, but I wanted to share the video with you so you can hear that crazy audio. I’m curious if you’ve ever heard something like that before. It’s not the typical Samurai chatter or howling. I have some theories on what it was doing, but I’ll let you come to your own conclusions first.”
